//: Used in: components/billing/VisibilitySheet (visibilitySheet namespace). Explains how business visibility works (page + budget), owns the <cause>Body prose (cause keys from useVisibilityCause; {{min}} = formatted MIN_VISIBILITY_BUDGET_CENTS), and lists the ways back. Method titles come from the shared billing namespace; {{surcharge}} = formatted PAYG.SURCHARGE_CENTS.
title: How visibility works
intro: To show up on the Tagly map you need two things: a business page, and budget to reward customers for sharing. If either is missing, customers can't see you.
noPageBody: You don't have a business page yet. Customers can only find and share businesses that have a page on Tagly. Create yours to get started.
activateBody: Your business shows up on the Tagly map only when you can reward customers for sharing. Add credits or link a card and you'll start showing up on Tagly.
lapsedBody: Your budget ran out. Your business shows up on the Tagly map only when you can reward customers for sharing. Add credits or link a card and you'll show up on Tagly again.
lapsedCardIssueBody: Your card stopped working, so pay as you go is paused. Update your card or add credits and your business will show up on Tagly again.
lapsedLowCreditsBody: You need at least {{min}} in credits to show up on Tagly. Add credits or link a card and your business will be visible again.
lapsedNegativeBody: Your balance went below zero because a share reward was paid out that it didn't cover. Add credits to cover the difference and your business will show up on Tagly again.

page.title: Business page
page.body: Create your business page so customers can find you and start sharing.

credits.body: Top up ahead of time. Credits are spent only when someone shares you.

payg.body: Link a card and pay per share automatically, plus {{surcharge}} per charge.
